# Mathilde Cerioli, PhD

> Cognitive neuroscientist working on child development and AI.

Innovation fulfils its purpose when it improves lives across generations. Protecting children and supporting their development are part of what makes it progress. Developmental science helps us understand what children need to thrive. As a researcher, I bring together expertise across disciplines and work with policymakers and companies to translate that knowledge into how AI is designed, assessed, and governed.

## Research and roles

At everyone.AI, I lead research on how AI interactions may shape children’s learning, autonomy, and relationships. I bring developmental science and AI expertise together to identify what needs studying, define observable behaviors, and build assessment methods that researchers and product teams can use.

- [Anthropomorphic AI & Adolescents: A Global Design Question](https://mathilde-gif.github.io/research/commentary/anthropomorphic-ai-adolescents-a-global-design-question): A Science Diplomacy Grid commentary on translating adolescent development into international AI governance and design decisions.

- [Designing AI for Adolescents](https://mathilde-gif.github.io/research/commentary/designing-ai-for-adolescents): An authored example of how the same advice can carry different developmental implications when its relational framing changes.
- [Vlan Podcast! Nos enfants à l'ère de l'IA](https://mathilde-gif.github.io/media/vlan-podcast-nos-enfants-a-l-ere-de-l-ia): Avec Grégory Pouy, une conversation en deux parties sur l’enfance, les relations avec l’IA, l’apprentissage et les décisions auxquelles les parents font face.

- [Adolescents & Anthropomorphic AI: Rethinking Design for Wellbeing](https://mathilde-gif.github.io/research/adolescents-anthropomorphic-ai): Examining how human-like AI interactions may affect adolescents, and what these questions mean for design and research.

- [AI’s Impact on Children: Scrolling to death Podcast](https://mathilde-gif.github.io/media/ais-impact-on-children-scrolling-to-death-podcast): With Nicki Petrossi, a conversation about AI and child development, preserving face-to-face interaction, and helping families understand and discuss AI.
- [Keynote, Shaping Tomorrow’s Mind: Advancing Beneficial AI for Children](https://mathilde-gif.github.io/speaking/science-diplomacy-summit-2025): A Science Diplomacy Summit talk and fireside conversation about bringing developmental evidence into AI decisions.

- [Stanford SAFE Annual Meeting Panel](https://mathilde-gif.github.io/speaking/stanford-safe-annual-meeting-panel): A Stanford Center for AI Safety panel on developmental risks, behavior assessment, and responsibility in AI design.

- [The Future of Child Development in the AI Era](https://mathilde-gif.github.io/research/future-child-development-ai-era): Bringing developmental science and AI expertise together to identify questions that should guide research, design, and policy.
- [CALIBER and Aïa | Mathilde Cerioli](https://mathilde-gif.github.io/research/caliber): A shared language for research, product teams and policy: measuring how AI interacts with young people, beginning with teens and emotional reliance.
